name: Corwen
title: Provisioner of the Gate Court
examine: Thinned blood: pointed ears, human years. He walked west a decade before the gate opened and was let in, which nobody outside had managed in a century. What he gave up to stay, he does not say.
lines: The wood provides. I just weigh it and take a cut. Smallest job in the city, best view in the world.
You want to know how I got in. Everyone asks. I knocked for three years. Take from that what you like.
They count my age in their heads when they talk to me. I can see them doing it. They are always gentle after.
